assertions.name: binding_routes_agree
assertions.source: AME2020 binding_energy_per_A x A  vs  Z*D(1H)+N*D(n)-D(Z,A)

description: AME 2020 total nuclear binding energies for the canonical light isotopes (D, T, 3He, 4He, 5Li, 6Li, 7Li, 8Be, 9Be) plus the two alpha-conjugate cluster / shell-closure points 12C (3-alpha) and 16O (doubly-magic). Read from the VENDORED AME2020 table via codata_constants.ame_binding_mev, not hand-entered. COMPARISON-ONLY validation values, NOT prediction inputs: used to form `err = pred - B_AME`. Per the AGENTS.md three-calibration discipline (CAL-1 m_e, CAL-2 D_beta, CAL-3 D_pi), importing them as upstream inputs to a mass / binding pipeline would inflate the calibration count beyond the allowed 3.

parameters.source: AME2020 mass.mas20 (Huang, Wang, Kondev, Audi, Naimi, Chinese Physics C45 030002, 2021), vendored at qou-mass/src/qou_mass/data/ame2020.json from computations/data/ame2020.mas20.txt
parameters.precision_note: Values are read as strings and carried as mpmath.mpf inside workdps(>=50); serialized via _precision.fmt. No float64 anywhere on this path.
